name: Switchback Jackal — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Switchback Jackal from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Switchback Jackal" but are not part of the Switchback Jackal entry, which is unchanged.

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate and warm plains
Organization solitary, pair, or pack (5–12)
Treasure none

Jackals are small canine pack hunters. With fur ranging from tawny to black, jackals are marked by their oversized, pointed ears. They use clever tactics to surround and bring down larger prey, hanging back while large predators take their fill but driving away smaller scavengers so the pack can pick over the remains. Their yipping cries are unnerving in the lone, dry lands where they dwell.
